from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4df046a8.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # The colored object slides toward the straight barrier; color 8 marks
    # the cell just behind the object on the side away from the barrier.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    barrier = next(((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2), None)
    if barrier is None: return out
    br, bc = barrier
    bg = grid[0][0]
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    if not pts: return out
    # barrier is a vertical line in these tasks
    left = bc < w//2
    minc, maxc = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    shift = (bc + 1 - minc) if left else (bc - 1 - maxc)
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = bg
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c+shift] = grid[r][c]
    edge = minc+shift-1 if left else maxc+shift+1
    for r in range(h):
        if 0 <= edge < w and grid[r][edge] == bg: out[r][edge] = 8
    return out
''')
